description: This source file defines the JobGenerator class responsible for generating Spark Streaming jobs, managing checkpointing, and cleaning up DStream metadata within the Spark Streaming scheduler.

classes.name: JobGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates Spark Streaming jobs, handles checkpointing, and manages DStream metadata cleanup.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the job generator, including event loop and checkpoint handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the job generator, optionally waiting for ongoing jobs and checkpoints to complete.

methods.name: onBatchCompletion
methods.description: Callback invoked when a batch has been processed, triggers metadata cleanup.

methods.name: onCheckpointCompletion
methods.description: Callback invoked when a batch checkpoint has been written, may trigger checkpoint data cleanup.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming events for job generation, metadata clearing, and checkpointing.

methods.name: startFirstTime
methods.description: Starts the generator for the first time, initializing timers and graph.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the generator based on checkpoint data, rescheduling unprocessed batches.

methods.name: generateJobs
methods.description: Generates jobs for a specific batch time, handles errors, and triggers checkpointing.

methods.name: clearMetadata
methods.description: Clears metadata for a batch, manages checkpointing or cleanup depending on configuration.

methods.name: clearCheckpointData
methods.description: Deletes checkpoint data and associated block metadata for a batch.

methods.name: doCheckpoint
methods.description: Performs checkpointing for a batch if conditions are met.

methods.name: markBatchFullyProcessed
methods.description: Marks a batch as fully processed, updating lastProcessedBatch.
